title: Account Executive, Product Sales (Billing) - Grower
description:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in the Stripe portfolio. Revenue and Finance Automation (RFA) Product Sales is tasked with attacking a $100B market opportunity for back-office finance automation across billing, tax, revenue reporting, and data.
 What you'll do
 As a Billing Account Executive (Grower) at Stripe, you'll use your sales and product expertise to help drive growth to existing Stripe customers. You'll collaborate with the core sales, marketing, product marketing, and product teams to develop deep product and industry knowledge and drive strategic deals. You'll be instrumental in leading in-depth product discussions with existing and prospective customers—and building and executing against our go-to-market strategy.
 Responsibilities
 Build deep, resilient, and multi-threaded relationships across SMB client organizations, with the ability to articulate value across different functions and key business stakeholders.
 The capability to develop and execute formal Strategic Account Plans that map out the client organization, identify short-term and long-term growth opportunities, and forecast renewal or expansion cycles
 Proactive communication and transparency with consistent value-adding engagements, updates, and ability to manage expectations effectively. Acting as a trusted advisor rather than merely a vendor

title: Executive Assistant III
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.
 We’re looking for a resourceful, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to support two Vice Presidents across our UK business and EMEA Technology organisation. In this role, you’ll help leaders operate effectively by managing calendars, coordinating travel and events, supporting meeting preparation, and maintaining strong documentation and record-keeping practices.
 You’ll partner closely with teams in the UK and internationally, including the Affirm Leadership Support Team, and cross-functional partners across the business. You’ll report directly to the VP, Country Manager UK and the VP, EU Engineering
 What You’ll Do
 Provide high-quality administrative support to two Vice Presidents
 Manage inboxes, calendars, scheduling, and meeting prioritisation to help leaders use their time effectively
 Co-ordinate core meetings in the daily / weekly / monthly operating plan for both leaders, ensuring attendance, drafting and distributing agendas, preparing materials, creating decks / notion pages, communicating with attendees and ensuring follow up actions are shared in a timely manner and tracked to completion.
 Manage incoming correspondence, including email and physical mail, and coordinate timely intake and forwarding from the managed office facility
 Ensure leaders are fully prepared for all core meetings that they attend linking all relevant documentation into calendar invites and providing timely reminders, blocking off time in diaries to ensure sufficient preparation and review time.

title: Staff Engineer - Content Platform
description:
Content Platform is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and delivering every piece of content on Spotify — from music and podcasts to audiobooks. Within Content Platform, the Media domain owns the end-to-end media pipeline, from the moment content arrives through to seamless playback for listeners around the world. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to provide architectural leadership across this media platform. You’ll help shape and drive the technical direction from ingestion through transcoding, packaging, storage, delivery, and playback. This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, understands the trade-offs between codec choices and infrastructure costs, and can drive technical strategy across multiple teams at scale.
 What You'll Do
 Define and drive the long-term architectural direction for Spotify's media pipeline across Content Platform.
 Lead large-scale technical initiatives that span multiple squads and organizations, including projects such as media delivery, codec rollouts, and future playback capabilities.
 Partner closely with engineering managers, product managers, and senior engineers to align technical strategy with product priorities, reliability goals, and cost efficiency, acting as a key technical counterpart for media architecture.
 Guide architectural decisions across media ingestion, transcoding, packaging, storage, content delivery, and playback.
 Author and review RFCs, architecture decision records, and technical design documents that guide engineering teams and leadership.
 Mentor senior engineers across the organization, helping raise technical quality, architectural thinking, and engineering excellence.
 Bring a cost-aware engineering mindset by understanding how media architecture decisions impact compute, storage, CDN utilization, and long-term platform sustainability.

title: Sr. Sustainability Consultant - Fokus PCF/LCA @ Climate Tech Start-up (m/w/d) - 100% Remote möglich
description:
Bist Du auf der Suche nach einem Job mit Sinn?
 Dann unterstütze mit uns große Unternehmen dabei ihre Emissionen schneller zu reduzieren.
 Um unser Wachstum in der DACH-Region weiter zu beschleunigen, suchen wir eine:n ( Sr.) Sustainability Consultant (m/w/d). Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (C1) werden benötigt.
 Über Global Changer:
 Global Changer ist ein innovatives Climate-Tech-Unternehmen, das B2B-Kunden eine KI gestützte Sustainability Management Plattform anbietet, um CCFs und PCFs schneller zu berechnen und Net-Zero und regulatorischen Anforderungen zu erreichen.
 Unsere Mission ist es, Unternehmen dabei zu unterstützen ihre Emissionen möglichst schnell zu reduzieren und damit eine lebenswerte Welt zu erhalten. Wieso Unternehmen? Weil sie auf einen Großteil der Emissionen einen direkten oder indirekten Einfluss haben und wir so einen möglichst großen Impact erreichen.
 Zu unseren Kunden gehören Unternehmen wie Heraeus (eines der größten Familienunternehmen Deutschlands), Bünting und Tchibo. Zu unseren Partnern gehören z.B. die Commerzbank, SCHUFA und die sustainable AG (eine der größten Nachhaltigkeitsberatungen in DE).
 Aufgaben
 Wir suchen eine:n Sr. Sustainability Consultant mit Fokus auf PCFs/LCA, der/die sich leidenschaftlich für das wohlergehen unseres Planeten einsetzen möchte.
 Wir schätzen Erfahrung und Werte mehr als akademische Abschlüsse.
 Du wirst...
 unseren PCF / LCA Kundenprozess aufbauen, stetig weiterentwickeln und mit Kunden durchführen
 Betreuung von Kunden und Aufbau von Regelwerken für PCFs / LCAs für Kunden
 Validierung von PCFs / LCAs
 Unsere Software maßgeblich mitgestalten
 Qualifikation
 MUST: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (C2), da wir hauptsächlich auf Deutsch mit unseren Kund:innen kommunizieren
 MUST: Mind. 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Nachhaltigkeitsberatung oder in der Nachhaltigkeitsabteilung eines Unternehmen - Fokus auf PCF oder LCA
 MUST: Du verfügst über eine Hands-on-Mentalität und zumindest im nächsten halben Jahr operativ mitan…
